title: Outright laughter by about 6 months
summary: Most babies laugh by about 6 months, CDC says.
body: Laughter is a separate 6-month social entry, after the 4-month chuckle that CDC said was not yet a full laugh. The page does not require one pitch or one length of sound. Its 'most' is 75 percent or more, the materials are not a screening instrument, and a quieter baby is not diagnosed by this card. The month is the US month.

sources.title: Milestones by 6 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports the social/emotional milestone 'Laughs'.
